entities.summary: Kurmangazy Sagyrbayuly was a Kazakh composer, instrumentalist, and folk artist. He influenced Kazakh musical culture. He was born in 1823 in the Bukey Horde. He is buried in the Astrakhan region of Lower Volga in today's Russian Federation.
